description: Per-case overrides applied on top of doc/spec/case_inventory.json for the Linux reference DUT (other DUT platforms supply their own overrides file via --inventory-overrides). Two independent axes: (1) `expected:false` (+ `reason`) marks a spec case the harness intentionally cannot cover (e.g. wall-time-permanent-deferred shapes) — counted as a gap by `--vs-spec`; (2) `platform_known_fail:true` (+ `platform_known_fail_ref`) marks a case that fails on this file's target platform due to platform-specific kernel/stack deviations from RFC MUST/SHOULD but passes on a strict-RFC DUT — kept ACTIVE in coverage reports so spec coverage stays honest, and filtered out of CI/smoke skip lists via `--exclude-platform-known-fail`. The two axes are disjoint in practice but can coexist on a single entry. Schema v3 renamed the second axis from `linux_known_fail` when the lwIP DUT became the second platform consumer.
